messages:
nisha (design): Quick sync on the Private setup wizard stepper and focus order. On small screens the 'Run preflight checks' button scrolls the stepper off-screen and keyboard users lose context. Ideas?
cole (product): UX goal: make it obvious which check is running and keep primary nav visible. Maybe pin the stepper header and show an inline progress toast rather than scrolling.
evan (frontend): Pinning header is doable. Also we should announce step changes for screen reader users: e.g., 'Step 2 of 5: Network checks' via a sr-only region. Use aria-live="polite".
pat (eng): Backend emits progress states: queued/running/succeeded/failed. We can send minimal deltas so frontend only updates the sr region when the step actually changes.
maya (a11y): Important: when a modal/help drawer opens it should move focus into it. But for non-modal progress updates we should not shift focus. Use an aria-live region for progress and role="status" for step announcements.
nisha (design): Microcopy note: current primary CTA says 'Run checks' which some users misinterpret as a destructive or system-wide job. Alternatives: ['Run preflight', 'Start check', 'Verify connection', 'Run network check']. Which reads clearest?
cole (product): Prefer 'Run preflight' or 'Run network check' because it's explicit. Keep CTA short. We should A/B test with new users.
evan (frontend): Also consider button behavior: change 'Run preflight' to a two-state button: default 'Run preflight' -> disabled when running -> shows spinner + 'Checking...' to avoid ambiguous states. Ensure button has aria-pressed or aria-busy as appropriate.
pat (eng): For bulk checks we currently run probes in parallel. If the UI pins the stepper header we might need to throttle how often we update the DOM to avoid jank. Debounce updates to 300ms.
maya (a11y): For sr-only step text use something like: 'Progress: step 2 of 5. Network check in progress.' Append result when done: 'Network check failed. Suggested next step: open troubleshooting.' Keep messages concise.
nisha (design): Visual affordance: add a compact inline status badge to each step row (tiny icon + one-word status) so sighted users can scan without opening drawer. For failed states show a calm 'Could not reach host' message rather than 'Failed'.
cole (product): Also question about CTA copy at the bottom: 'Save & proceed' vs 'Continue' vs 'Proceed'. Which is clearer if the step performs a mutation (writes telemetry or marks as verified)?
evan (frontend): If running checks doesn't change server state, avoid 'Save'. Use 'Continue' or 'Proceed'. If it does persist a setting, 'Save & continue' is OK. We should align copy with the actual side effects.
pat (eng): Implementation detail: we can make the checkbox 'Mark as resolved' local-only until the user confirms. That affects whether we say 'Save & continue'.
maya (a11y): Keyboard flow: after running checks, focus should move to the first actionable item in the results region (e.g., 'Retry' button) so keyboard users can immediately act. But ensure focus isn't stolen mid-run.
nisha (design): I'll push a compact stepper variant to Figma with pinned header, inline badges, and new CTA text options. Link: https://figma.com/file/new-stepper-wizard
cole (product): I'll update the spec with chosen CTA: 'Run preflight' + final step CTA 'Continue' (unless a save occurs). Add notes about analytics and A/B test.
evan (frontend): I'll implement pinned header + aria-live sr region and ensure button states map to aria-busy. Will open PR and tag @maya for a11y review.
pat (eng): We'll add throttling on events and include explicit step identifiers in probe payloads.
maya (a11y): I'll run a screen reader walkthrough once PR is up. Also verify no excessive announcements during retries.
deploy-bot: Deploy checklist: feature-branch 'wizard-stepper-focus' created. CI queued.
cole (product): Great work. Goal: ship this next sprint so Private/VPC guided setup feels stable on laptop sizes. Thanks all. :rocket:
